title: 第12章 木佛寺二第13章 意外收获
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
木佛寺坐落于环阳市南区。
这座历经近千年风雨的古刹，本身便是一段活着的史诗。
尽管在漫长的时间中，其间一部分的殿阁因年久失修曾几度倾颓。
后世屡有重建，但其积淀的历史厚重与人文价值却是极高。
它亦是虞国屈指可数的全国重点文物保护单位之一。
木佛寺雄踞于山顶，终日香客游人络绎不绝，山道上总是人影幢幢。
此刻，朝阳初升，金辉泼洒而下，晨雾犹自袅袅未散。
自山脚仰望而去。
便见在那翠峦叠嶂的峰顶处，一片金瓦朱檐在曦光与薄雾间隐现，恍如梵境临尘。
——咚！
下一刻，一声沉浑的钟鸣自山顶荡开，悠悠传遍山野。
蜿蜒如龙的石阶上，游客的身影如蚁，正缓缓向上攀行。
一部分人听到钟声，双手合十，闭眸祷告。
这山本就不低，山势颇陡。
每上行一段，便可见到在半途拄着登山杖、倚栏歇息的游客。
亦有赶早登顶看完日出的人，正说笑着拾级而下。
路旁一方凸起的巨岩上，一对年轻情侣正挨坐着休息。
两人拆开零食，拧开瓶盖，大口补充着体力。
“这山也太高了……我腿肚子都在打颤。”
一个脸上长着青春痘的男生抹了把额头的汗，喘着气说道。

“谁让你平时不锻炼？一个大男人，体力还不如我呢，这才爬到哪儿呀……”
戴圆框眼镜的女生扶了扶镜架，瞥了男友一眼，语气里带着几分嫌弃。
男生张了张嘴，想辩驳，却实在找不到话头，只得讪讪灌了口水。
就在这时，下方山道传来一阵喧嚷。
两人循声望去，只见八名赤膊壮汉正扛着一架竹轿，步履稳健地快速上行。
轿上悠然坐着一个身形清瘦的寸头青年。
“这也太爽了吧……”
青春痘男生忍不住低声道，眼里尽是羡慕。
“那抬轿服务我问过了，单程就要两千，往返四千你想坐？”
圆脸女生挑眉问道。
男生表情一僵。
四千块不是拿不出，但为了省段山路花这个钱，终究肉疼。
“算了算了。”
他摇摇头，收回目光。
但是嘴巴还是嘟囔一句，似在给自己找借口。
“爬山本来就是为了锻炼身体，坐轿子就没有意义了，还浪费钱，有这钱干什么不好。”
周遭其他游客也大多如此，或注目或低语，神色间多少流露出几分向往。
竹轿上的，正是胡隆。
他这身体虽恢复了些元气，却还远不到能徒步登山的程度。
既然有更省力的法子，又何苦折腾自己。
content_en:
Mufo Temple is located in the Southern District of Huanyang City.
This ancient temple, which has gone through nearly a thousand years of ups and downs, is itself a living epic.
Although over a long period of time, some of the palaces and pavilions fell into disrepair several times.
It has been repeatedly rebuilt in later generations, but its accumulated historical depth and humanistic value are extremely high.
It is also one of the few national key cultural relics protection units in Yu State.
The Wooden Buddha Temple stands on the top of the mountain, with an endless stream of pilgrims and tourists all day long, and there are always people on the mountain road.
At this moment, the morning sun is rising, golden light is pouring down, and the morning mist is still curling up.
Looking up from the foot of the mountain.
Then, at the top of the green mountains, a piece of golden tiles and red eaves loomed between the sunlight and mist, like a Brahma realm coming to the dust.
——Boom!
The next moment, a deep bell rang from the top of the mountain, spreading throughout the mountains and fields.
On the stone steps that wind like a dragon, the figures of tourists are like ants, slowly climbing up.
Some people heard the bell, clasped their hands, closed their eyes and prayed.
This mountain is not low, it is quite steep.
Every time you go up, you can see tourists holding trekking poles and resting on the railing halfway.
There were also people who had rushed to the top early to watch the sunrise and were chatting and laughing while going down the stairs.
On a large raised rock beside the road, a young couple was sitting next to each other and resting.
The two opened the snacks, unscrewed the bottle caps, and took big gulps to replenish their energy.
"This mountain is too high...my calves are trembling."
A boy with acne on his face wiped the sweat from his forehead and gasped.
"Who told you not to exercise on a daily basis? You are a grown man, but your physical strength is not as good as mine. Where can you climb now..."
The girl wearing round glasses adjusted her frames and glanced at her boyfriend, with a hint of disgust in her tone.
The boy opened his mouth, wanting to argue, but he couldn't find the words to say, so he had to drool.
At this moment, there was a noise from the mountain road below.
The two of them followed the sound and saw eight shirtless strong men carrying a bamboo sedan, moving up quickly and steadily.
Sitting leisurely on the sedan chair was a thin, short-haired young man.
"This is so cool..."
The boy with acne couldn't help but whisper, his eyes full of envy.
"I've asked about the sedan service. It costs 2,000 for one way and 4,000 for round trip. Do you want to take it?"
The round-faced girl asked with raised eyebrows.
The boy's expression stiffened.
It's not that I can't afford four thousand yuan, but it hurts to spend this money just to save a mountain road.
"Forget it, forget it."
He shook his head and looked away.
But he still muttered something, as if he was making excuses for himself.
"The purpose of climbing mountains is to exercise. Riding in a sedan chair is meaningless. It is also a waste of money. What can you do with the money?"
Most of the other tourists around him were doing the same, either paying attention or whispering, and their expressions showed some yearning.
The person on the bamboo sedan was none other than Hu Long.
Although his body has regained some strength, it is still far from being able to hike up mountains.
Since there is a more labor-saving way, why bother yourself.
